title: nixos/vmalert: support multiple instances
reason: Applicable: real vmalert module + wired test (nixos/tests/victoriametrics/vmalert.nix, a dedicated file within the victoriametrics test directory). Real diff is a large restructuring: the whole module converts from a single top-level services.vmalert.{enable,package,settings} shape to a per-instance services.vmalert.instances.<name> shape, with package staying top-level (options.services.vmalert.package = ...) but enable genuinely disappearing from the top level entirely.
targets_toml: single target vmalert, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,vmalert], watch=[enable].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: A real, cleanly witnessed materially-relevant PASS at base (check_base exits 0 -- the only fully-clean side this batch): `mkIf cfg.enable {...}` witnessed=True against a real test instance (victoriametrics, enable=true at nixos/tests/victoriametrics/vmalert.nix line 59). At head, the top-level enable is genuinely gone (confirmed: grep for 'enable = mkOption'/'mkEnableOption' at top level of vmalert.nix returns nothing after the restructuring), so OptionNotFound is correct. Flagging per the same rule as wakapi/tayga/yggdrasil's own PASS findings -- a real base-side PASS that then transitions to a genuine removal.
